headline: German Data Regulator Opens Investigation Into Deutsche Bank Over Data Leak
summary: A German state data regulator launched an investigation into Deutsche Bank following a massive data leak involving 15 million files, probing possible data protection violations.
why: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest banking institution, and regulatory probes into cybersecurity and data compliance can result in financial penalties and reputational risks.
